title: Non-Destructive Testing & Inspection

canonicalTerminology.definition: Non-destructive testing examines materials or components for relevant indications without impairing their intended future usefulness.

claims.text: NDT method selection, personnel competence, equipment and acceptance criteria must follow the applicable controlled procedure and sector or product requirements.
claims.applicabilityNote: Level-neutral educational statement; adapt depth without changing the canonical fact.

visualSpecs.purpose: Compare NDT methods by physical principle and typical information obtained, without giving acceptance thresholds.

prohibitedUnsupportedClaims: Do not invent flaw acceptance thresholds or calibration settings.
Do not imply training exercises constitute certified NDT examination or personnel qualification.
